correctness.rationale: For X=Ind_2(K4□K4) the induced-degree≤1 face predicate, exhaustively evaluated for all 2^16 subsets, gives cardinality face vector (1,16,120,384,528,144). Independent bitset elimination of the full mod-two simplicial boundaries gives ranks (15,105,279,144). Since characteristic-zero ranks are at least these and chain dimension/im(d^2=0) force upper bounds successively at exactly the same values, rational reduced homology is concentrated in degree three of dimension 105. The full graph automorphism group is (S4×S4)⋊C2 of order 1152. Independently enumerated its 1152 cell permutations, computed the exact signed Lefschetz trace over all invariant faces, and confirmed full-group trace sum zero. The packaged verifier independently computes invariant faces via orbit cycle unions, 20 conjugacy-class values, tensor Specht multiplicity matrix, ± diagonal extensions and row/diagonal invariant dimensions 3,5,3; the complete script and proof were read. A finite exhaustive calculation establishes only this fixed board, not a theorem for every rook graph.
